title: The tour was great, short but comprehensive full of important information our guide Cristina was great
text: The experience is great, but it doesn't include the Nazarí Palace. But the tour was great regardless
author: MariaAlejandra_U

title: Fabulous tour with Juan
text: We had a lovely 2 hour afternoon tour with Juan. It was a private tour which I loved and best of all the tickets were included. Juan was very easy to communicate with also. We toured the garden palace area and the Alhambra. Both are a must! We learned so much and the views are to die for. Highly recommend
author: ann_b

title: Fantastic Alhambra Experience
text: Lots of steps, so fairly demanding. Worth it though! Our guide Juan was outstanding and his English was perfect! He also waited patiently for us when we arrived late from Malaga. Thoroughly enjoyed the exoerience!
author: Brenda_W

title: Professional and willing to help you get last minute tickets and an amazing guided tour.
text:
If you find yourself in Granada needing last minute tickets for the Alhambra, for whatever reason, do not hesitate to reach out to Granada te Guía for help.

In my case, I had booked my Alhambra tickets weeks in advance with a tour, but because of the national blackout in Spain on April 28, 2025 that stopped all trains for practically an entire day, I was not able to get to Granada on time, and I lost them.
